integrity: Contains self-contained mathematical argument, exact enumerative certificates, and a standalone reproducibility script. No independent audit or external validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for linear binary words of Hamming weight three observed through full multiplicities of length-three substrings. title: Exactly 46 binary three-mer spectra at weight three and a sharp dominant fiber
